summaries.en: Alibaba’s open-code-review is a fast, efficient, battle-tested code review tool built for Alibaba-scale use. It uses a hybrid architecture combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent to provide precise line-level comments. It includes a built-in multi-language ruleset covering NPE, thread safety, XSS, and SQL injection, and is compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic. Written in Go, the project has 24,739 stars and 1,811 forks.
